content: निर्भेद .²1 Bursting, dividing, splitting asunder. .²2 A split, rent. .²3 Disclosure, betrayal. .²4 Explicit mention or declaration; निर्भेदादृतेऽपि मालविकायामयमुपन्यासः शङ्कयति <ls>M. 4</ls>. .²5 The bed of a river. .²6 Determination of an affair, event. .²7 Destruction; पृथिव्याश्चापि निर्भेदो दृष्ट एव सनातनः <ls>Rām. 1. 40. 4</ls>.
